The vault implementation is copied unchanged from [Papan src/vault.js at c01beea](https://github.com/chelij/papan/blob/c01beea/src/vault.js), renamed to `.mjs` for standalone Node.js imports. It generates native Papan files for compatibility tests; it is not part of the extension or release ZIP. The small portrait.mp4 is Papan's synthetic media test fixture. Both are covered by this repository's GPL-3.0-or-later license.

`pose-attachment.papan` is an encrypted export from the production Papan 0.2.3 pose attachment implementation, based on desktop `153fbc8` with unpublished local changes, created on Linux on 8 October 2026. Its test-only password is `pose-check-password`. One original video and its DWPose attachment share a pin; the attachment uses optional v1 `poseFor` metadata. Each clip has 51 frames at 24 fps (2.125 seconds). The source is the public [rtmlib demo image](https://github.com/Tau-J/rtmlib/blob/main/demo.jpg), converted to a short test clip with synthetic audio; it contains no user media. The pose clip is silent. The fixture checks native encryption, attachment association, exact media import, reference execution, and workflow persistence; it does not establish H3 generation quality or a published release pair.

Fixture SHA-256: `b8eda09ab7ef092daa9d323dea3509c28f757b3522b76429c8d281acc4487b63`. Production writer source hashes:

- `src/collection-files.js`: `f5fdff31a5feded9082f4f049e008fe551b14a525dfddbc1d63c2240de7dab74`
- `src/pose-pin.js`: `6af4943dcf0ce9fde178f207cb4cbc9c7a33efa6e9e78d48af58123af881006c`
- `src/vault.js`: `cf82c453e169cb23e8b2382944f66d6a0235e49609692db90e17c6d5213b0819`

`live-library.mjs` runs the real desktop library, protection and local service from an explicitly supplied `PAPAN_DESKTOP_DIR`. It creates a fresh library from the test's synthetic manifest, grants two collections, and keeps a third unshared. Its commands mutate only that isolated library. Native checks on 12 October 2026 use the unpublished desktop source based on `d8145fb`, with `src/library-service.js` SHA-256 `9278138bee752c8a523f20656d079bfe8d40286e06cb6679c7eda1879ac98884`. The endpoint tests use synthetic images and `portrait.mp4`; the live UI suite reuses the source and pose from the encrypted fixture above, plus synthetic images. This establishes source-to-source protocol v1 compatibility, including protected streaming and workflow persistence, rather than a published release pair or inference quality. Exact checked extension hashes and runtime versions are retained in `artifacts/live-library-check.json`.

On 14 October 2026, the v0.1.4 release candidate repeated all 21 tests on Python 3.12.12 and 3.13.12 against desktop v0.3.2 candidate `5c66d7e`, with provider SHA-256 `64978a366d948a23d41ce80681d3e249bef081fc3fc40357bdf9df71d7965399`. Both classic and Nodes 2.0 live suites pass against that provider after its cancellation fix; saved-file suites pass with the unchanged native fixture above. Runtime: Linux x64, ComfyUI 0.39.2 (`3c1b7a17`), frontend 1.53.10. `artifacts/release-v0.1.4/` retains results and release payload hashes. CI main checks pin this candidate; tagged checks use published desktop v0.3.2. Fixture provenance and contents remain unchanged.
